notes: Maintained by smartout-page-polish skill, Phase 8. One entry per polished dashboard page. BFF /api/botsson/voice/session-context reads this file and ships it in context_init alongside the workforce snapshot — same bootstrap pipe (2026-05-13). Run `pnpm --filter web site-map:validate` after edits.

routes.purpose: Daily operations console — open/close session, manage roster, track tasks, surface deviations, broadcast messages, swap variant views.

tools.name: getDaySnapshot
tools.description: Get the full day snapshot — phase, bemanning, oppgaver, avvik, lønn og omsetning. Call this first when the manager asks any open-ended question about today.

tools.name: getRosterForDay
tools.description: Get the staff roster for the active date — who is on shift, who is upcoming, who has finished. Use when manager asks 'kor mange er på vakt?', 'hvem jobber i dag?', or wants a name list.

tools.name: getOpenDeviations
tools.description: List open, acknowledged and escalated deviations for the workspace. Use when manager asks 'hva må jeg fikse?', 'hvilke avvik er åpne?', or wants to triage incidents.

tools.name: getSessionTasks
tools.description: List session tasks grouped by hook (pre_open / open / scheduled / pre_close / close) with done vs active counts. Use when manager asks 'hvilke oppgaver gjenstår?'.

tools.name: getDayBudget
tools.description: Get budgeted revenue, labor cost and labor hours for the active date. Use when manager asks 'hva er omsetning i dag?' or 'kor mye lønn er planlagt?'.

tools.name: getDayActivity
tools.description: Get the timeline of events for the day — bookings, notes, tasks, deviations, punch-ins, punch-outs. Use when manager asks 'hva har skjedd så langt?' or wants a chronological recap.

tools.name: getCascadeMustDo
tools.description: Get cascade-derived urgent items (D1-D6 + C1-C4 dimensions) marked critical or should-do. Drives the MustDoCard on the day-control surface. Use when the manager asks 'hva må jeg fikse i dag?' or 'hvilke saker haster?'.

tools.name: openSession
tools.description: Open today's department_session — required before bemanning can clock in. Call when the manager says 'start dagen', 'åpne i dag', or 'open today'. Uses the active date and department from the day-control context.

tools.name: transitionSession
tools.description: Move the active session to its next phase. Targets: 'active' (start service), 'pending_signoff' (close shift for review), 'closed' (lock day), 'missed' (mark abandoned). Use when the manager confirms a phase change verbally.

tools.name: signoffSession
tools.description: Sign off the day after it is pending_signoff. Use when the manager says 'godkjenn dagen', 'lukk vakt', or confirms reconciliation and hours are correct. 'pending' submits for review (manager); 'close' finalises (admin only).

tools.name: addShift
tools.description: Add an unplanned shift for last-minute coverage on the active date. Requires an employeeId and a reason string for the audit trail (e.g. 'sykmelding kø'). Start and end times in HH:MM format.

tools.name: manualTimeEntry
tools.description: Admin retro-records a punch-in/out when the employee forgot or punch was lost. Requires a reason for audit. Provide punch times as full ISO 8601 timestamps.

tools.name: addSessionTask
tools.description: Add an ad-hoc task to a session hook (e.g. 'sjekk frysere før close'). The task appears in the TasksTab list. Provide a hookId to attach it to a specific hook, or omit to add as a free-standing task.

tools.name: toggleSessionTask
tools.description: Mark a session_task done or undone. Use when the manager confirms or reverses task completion. Provide the task UUID and the desired done state.

tools.name: sendBroadcast
tools.description: Broadcast a message to workspace members. Types: 'alert' (high-priority warning), 'reminder' (scheduled reminder), 'note' (informational). Voice-channel priority restrictions per ADR-0078 apply — gate denial is propagated back as ok:false.

tools.name: switchDayTab
tools.description: Switch the active tab inside day-control. Use when the manager asks to view a different section of today's view (e.g. 'vis bemanning', 'gå til oppgaver').

tools.name: switchDate
tools.description: Move day-control to a different date. Accepts ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) or relative ('yesterday', 'tomorrow', 'today'). Use when the manager asks to look at another day.

tools.name: switchVariantView
tools.description: Switch the dashboard variant. Use when manager asks to see a different surface ('vis avstemming', 'strategic view', 'aktivitetslogg'). Variants: oversikt, strategic, reconciliation, activity, todo.

tools.name: getStrategicSnapshot
tools.description: Get all 6 strategic KPIs for the workspace in one call: opplæringsberedskap, oppgavefullføring, tid-til-jobbklar, varekostnad, personalomsetning, fraværsrate — each with current value, target, and status. Call this first when the manager asks any open-ended question about workspace health, KPIs, or strategic status.

tools.name: getWorkforcePipeline
tools.description: Get workforce pipeline headcount snapshot: total active staff, new hires last 30 days, departures last 30 days, and employees currently in onboarding (trainee status). Use when manager asks 'kor mange ansatte har vi?', 'har vi tapt folk?', 'hvem er under opplæring?', or any headcount question.

tools.name: getTrainingStatus
tools.description: Get protocol assignment completion status across all workspace employees: total assignments, completed, pending (in progress), expired (missed deadline), and overall readiness percent. Use when manager asks 'er opplæringa i rute?', 'hvem har ikke fullført?', 'hva er opplæringsberedskapen?'.

tools.name: getSeasonProgress
tools.description: Get the active season name, type, date range, current lifecycle stage, and completed stages. Use when manager asks 'hvilken sesong er vi i?', 'hvor er vi i sesongen?', 'hva gjenstår i sesongen?', or any season-progress question.

tools.name: listReconciliationDays
tools.description: List pending and handled reconciliation days for the active date view. Returns shift counts, hours, decision progress, and approval status. Use when the manager asks 'hva gjenstår å avstemme?', 'hvilke dager er godkjent?', or wants an overview of the reconciliation surface.

tools.name: getReconciliationDetail
tools.description: Get the full breakdown for the selected reconciliation date — department sections, individual shifts with hours and per-shift decision status. Use when the manager asks 'vis meg detaljer for i går', 'hvilke vakter er bestridt?', or 'hvem er ikke godkjent?'.

tools.name: getRecentActivity
tools.description: Get the most recent activity log entries for this workspace. Use when the manager asks 'hva har skjedd?', 'vis aktivitetslogg', or wants a quick recap of recent events. Returns up to 20 entries by default.

tools.name: searchActivity
tools.description: Search the activity log by actor name, entity type, event keyword, or category. Use when manager asks about a specific person ('hva har Anna gjort?'), a specific type ('vis alle scheduling-hendelser'), or wants to filter by time. All params are optional — omit to return all recent entries.

tools.name: getActivitySummary
tools.description: Get an aggregated summary of workspace activity — entry counts by category, total event count, and the 5 most recent high-signal events. Use when manager asks for an overview or trend ('er det mye aktivitet i dag?', 'gi meg en oversikt').

tools.name: listTodos
tools.description: List all cascade-derived to-do items for the workspace, grouped by dimension (D1–D6, C1–C4) and urgency. Returns critical, should, and can_wait tasks with their group, dimension, title key, and navigation href. Use when the manager asks 'hva må jeg gjøre?', 'hvilke saker haster?', or 'vis alle gjøremål'.

common_intents: Hvor mange er på vakt i dag?

routes.purpose: Plan, publiser og juster vakter, åpne vakter, fravær og bytter for hele teamet uke for uke.

tools.name: getScheduleState
tools.description: Get the current schedule overview: which week is displayed, how many shifts, employees, coverage gaps, and draft/published counts. Call this first to understand what the manager is looking at.

tools.name: getShiftsForDay
tools.description: Get all shifts for a specific day. Returns employee names, times, roles, and status (draft/published). Use day name like 'monday' or date like '2026-03-03'.

tools.name: getEmployeeSchedule
tools.description: Get one employee's shifts and absences for the current week. Search by name (partial match).

tools.name: getCoverage
tools.description: Get staffing coverage for a specific day or the whole week. Shows gaps, overtime risks, and team coverage. If no day specified, returns week summary.

tools.name: getWeekOperationsSummary
tools.description: Get an operational summary for the currently displayed week: shifts, payroll/labor cost, bookings, budget signal, open/filled shifts, and absence breakdown (sick leave/vacation). Use this when the manager asks for a quick week health check.

tools.name: createShift
tools.description: Create a new shift. Requires employee name, day, start time, and end time. Role is optional.

tools.name: updateShift
tools.description: Update an existing shift. Find it by employee name + day, then change time, role, or notes.

tools.name: deleteShift
tools.description: Delete a shift. Find it by employee name + day. If multiple shifts, specify the time to disambiguate.

tools.name: publishShifts
tools.description: Publish draft shifts. Specify a day to publish all drafts for that day, or 'all' to publish everything.

tools.name: focusDay
tools.description: Scroll to a day in the visible schedule and highlight it for showcase guidance. Does not open the day planner.

tools.name: openDayPlanner
tools.description: Open the day planner for a specific day, scroll to that day in the schedule grid, and highlight it.

tools.name: closeDayPlanner
tools.description: Close the currently open day planner sheet if it is visible.

tools.name: addReservation
tools.description: Add a table reservation/booking for a specific day. Use when the user says 'legg til reservasjon', 'bordbestilling', 'det kommer gjester', or similar. Requires date, title (guest name), time, and guest count.

tools.name: updateReservation
tools.description: Update an existing reservation/booking. Find it by guest name + day. Use when the user says 'endre reservasjon', 'flytt til bord 20', 'endre antall gjester', 'avbestill', 'kanseller reservasjon', or similar.

tools.name: addSessionTask
tools.description: Add a task to a specific day's session (dagplan). Use when the user says 'legg til oppgave på dagen', 'dagsoppgave', 'gjøremål for fredag', or similar. The task will appear in the day's session and can be assigned to an employee.

tools.name: switchScheduleView
tools.description: Switch the schedule grid grouping. Options: 'ansatt' (by employee — default), 'jobb' (by job role), 'team' (by team), 'lokasjon' (by location). Use when the user says 'vis per jobb', 'grupper etter team', 'bytt til ansattvisning', etc.

tools.name: setTimePeriod
tools.description: Change how many weeks are displayed in the schedule. Options: 1 (one week), 2 (two weeks), 4 (month view), 8 (two months). Use when the user says 'vis en uke', 'manadsvisning', 'vis to uker', 'zoom ut', etc.

tools.name: showSingleDay
tools.description: Show only a single day in the schedule view (selects and highlights a date). Use when the user says 'vis bare mandag', 'zoom inn pa fredag', 'vis kun i dag', etc.

tools.name: filterSchedule
tools.description: Filter the schedule by role/situation. Use 'Alle' to clear filter. Use when the user says 'vis bare kokkene', 'filtrer pa servitor', 'fjern filter', etc.

tools.name: navigateToDate
tools.description: Navigate the schedule to a specific week or date. Accepts week number (e.g. 'uke 17'), a date (e.g. '16. april', '2026-04-16'), or relative navigation ('neste uke', 'forrige uke'). Use when the user says 'ga til uke 17', 'vis neste uke', 'hoppa til 16 april', etc.

tools.name: switchLayout
tools.description: Switch the schedule layout mode. Options: 'daily' (week plan/Ukeplan), 'monthly' (month calendar/Maned), 'list' (shift list/Vaktliste), 'grid' (staffing grid/Bemanning). Use when the user says 'vis vaktliste', 'bytt til manedsvisning', 'vis ukeplan', 'bemanning', etc.

common_intents: Show me next week's shift plan
Which employees are available on Friday?
Who is working the evening shift today?
Create a new shift for Monday morning
Publish all draft shifts for this week

routes.purpose: Datoer, sesonger, eventer og bookinger på ett sted — kalender, årshjul, eventliste og bordbookinger.

tools.name: getCalendarState
tools.description: Get the calendar's current state — visible cursor date, view (day/uke/måned), active tab, total event + booking counts, and which layers are toggled on. Call first when manager asks any open-ended calendar question.

tools.name: getEventsForRange
tools.description: Get events between two dates (inclusive). Use when manager asks 'hva skjer denne uka?', 'hvilke arrangementer i mars?', or wants a date-range listing.

tools.name: getBookingsForRange
tools.description: Get bookings between two dates (inclusive). Use when manager asks 'hvilke bord er reservert i helga?' or wants seat counts across days.

tools.name: getEventsForDay
tools.description: Get events on a specific date. Use when manager asks 'hva skjer i dag?' or 'hva er booket på fredag?'.

tools.name: getBookingsForDay
tools.description: Get bookings on a specific date — guests, time, seats. Use when manager asks 'hvor mange bord i kveld?'.

tools.name: getNextEvents
tools.description: Get the next N upcoming events from today. Use when manager asks 'hva er neste på agendaen?'. Default count: 5, max 20.

tools.name: proposeNewEvent
tools.description: Open the new-event drawer pre-filled with date + time. User reviews, edits, and confirms. Use when manager says 'legg inn et møte', 'opprett event', etc. NEVER saves directly — drawer requires manual save.

tools.name: proposeNewBooking
tools.description: Open the new-booking drawer. User fills guest + time + seats and confirms. Use when manager says 'ta inn en booking'.

tools.name: navigateCalendar
tools.description: Move the calendar cursor — 'today' jumps to today, 'prev'/'next' steps by view unit, 'date' jumps to a specific YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: switchCalendarView
tools.description: Switch the calendar view between day, week, and month. Norwegian aliases accepted: 'dag', 'uke', 'måned'.

tools.name: switchCalendarTab
tools.description: Switch the active tab — 'calendar' | 'year-wheel' | 'events' | 'bookings'. Use when user wants to see year wheel or list view.

tools.name: openDayInDayControl
tools.description: Open the day-control sheet for a specific date — drills into bemanning, oppgaver, avvik for that day. Use when manager asks 'åpne torsdag i dag-styringen'.

common_intents: Legg inn et arrangement på fredag

routes.purpose: Kanaler, direktemeldinger og talesamtaler — send meldinger, se historikk og bli med i aktive calls.

tools.name: listChannels
tools.description: List all channels the user can see, grouped by type (department, team, session, custom, direct, news, skill). Includes member count, unread count and last-message preview. Use when the user asks 'hvilke kanaler har jeg?', 'hvor mye er ulest?', or wants an overview.

tools.name: getActiveChannel
tools.description: Get details of the currently open channel — name, type, member count, unread count. Returns null when no channel is selected. Call this first when the user asks a question about 'this channel' / 'denne kanalen'.

tools.name: getRecentMessages
tools.description: Get the last 20 messages from the currently active channel — sender, content, time, reactions, attachments. Use when the user asks 'hva har skjedd i denne kanalen?', 'hva sa NN?', or wants a recap.

tools.name: getUnreadCount
tools.description: Get total unread message count and per-channel breakdown. Use when the user asks 'har jeg nye meldinger?', 'hvor mye er ulest?', or wants triage prioritization.

tools.name: getMyHelpdeskCount
tools.description: Get the count of open helpdesk tickets currently assigned to the user (engine_state with status waiting or active). Use when the user asks 'hva er Min KØ?', 'hvor mange åpne saker har jeg?', or wants their personal queue size.

tools.name: sendMessage
tools.description: Send a text message to the currently active channel. Use when the user says 'send melding ...', 'svar med ...', 'skriv at ...'. Always confirm the wording with the user verbally before invoking. Fails when no channel is open.

tools.name: createChat
tools.description: Create a 1:1 direct-message channel with another workspace member by profile_id. If the DM already exists, it returns the existing channel_id. Use when the user says 'start chat med NN', 'send DM til NN'. The caller must look up the profile_id first via the people directory.

tools.name: joinCall
tools.description: Join the active call in a channel — audio by default, video optional. If channelId is omitted, joins the call in the currently active channel. Use when the user says 'bli med på samtalen', 'join call', 'svar på anropet'. Fails when no channel is open and no channelId is supplied, or LiveKit auth fails.

routes.purpose: Hjelp og selvbetjening: chat med Botsson, meld panikksituasjoner, finn KB-artikler og kontaktkanaler.

tools.name: kb_query_voice_fallback
tools.description: Call this tool when the user asks about handbook content, policies, procedures, rules, routines, or any knowledge base question via voice. This capability is only available in chat — voice cannot answer KB queries. After calling this tool, speak the returned message verbatim.

tools.name: ui.navigate_to
tools.description: Smooth-scroll the /dashboard/help page to a known anchor (panic_bar, chat_hero, active_ticket_badge, quick_paths, curated_articles, kontakt_footer). Returns ok+scrolled_to on success or ok=false+reason on failure.

tools.name: ui.highlight_element
tools.description: Render an outline overlay and label badge on a known anchor on /dashboard/help. Auto-dismisses after duration_ms (default 5000 ms). Returns ok+highlighted on success or ok=false+reason on failure.

tools.name: ui.simulate_click
tools.description: Propose a click on an allow-listed UI element on /dashboard/help. ALWAYS shows a preview overlay with a 3-second confirm-delay BEFORE clicking. User must confirm. ESC cancels. Returns ok+state='previewing' immediately or ok=false+reason if denied (unknown target, authority disabled, voice channel). Allow-listed targets: panic_bar_human

tools.name: ui.submit_form
tools.description: STUB in v1 — no forms are allow-listed yet. Always returns ok=false with reason='no_forms_in_v1_allowlist'. Future versions will let Botsson fill + submit named forms via preview-confirm flow.

tools.name: ui.wait_for_state
tools.description: Wait until a known DOM predicate is met on /dashboard/help. Allow-listed predicates: panic_drawer_open, panic_drawer_closed. Returns ok+met=true+elapsed_ms when satisfied, ok+met=false+elapsed_ms on timeout. Read-only — no mutation.

common_intents: Jeg er låst ute av kontoen min

routes.purpose: Alle varsler om vakter, oppgaver, avvik og kontrakter — samlet på ett sted. Klikk for å gå til kilden.

tools.name: listNotifications
tools.description: List notifications for the current user. Filter by type (all|unread|shift|chat|task|deviation|approval|training|contract). Use when manager asks 'hva har skjedd?' or 'hva har jeg gått glipp av?'.

tools.name: getUnreadCount
tools.description: Get count of unread notifications for the current user. Use when user asks 'hvor mange uleste har jeg?'.

tools.name: markAsRead
tools.description: Mark one notification as read by id. Use when user confirms they've seen a specific notification.

tools.name: markAllAsRead
tools.description: Mark all notifications as read for the current user. Use when user says 'merk alle som lest'.

tools.name: filterNotifications
tools.description: Switch the notification list filter (all|unread|shift|chat|task|deviation|approval|training|contract). Use when user says 'vis bare avvik' or 'vis uleste'.

routes.purpose: Manage policies, protocols, training assignments, deviations — D3 compliance + C4 governance surface (redirects to /dashboard/hms umbrella).

tools.name: getGovernanceState
tools.description: Get the current governance dashboard state — overall workspace readiness %, total protocol count, overdue count, open deviation count, and active sub-tab. Call first when manager asks any open-ended governance or HMS question.

tools.name: listProtocols
tools.description: List all active D3-layer protocols with completion %, assignment counts, and policy type (haccp/safety/hr/operational/access/payroll/custom). Use when manager asks 'hvilke protokoller har vi?', 'hva er status på opplæringen?', or wants a compliance overview.

tools.name: getProtocolDetail
tools.description: Get detailed status breakdown for a single D3-layer protocol — completed / in_progress / not_started / expired / waived counts. Use when manager asks 'hvem har ikke fullfort [protokollnavn]?' or wants to drill into one protocol.

tools.name: listOverdueItems
tools.description: List D3-layer protocols that have expired assignments or completion below 80%. Use when manager asks 'hva er på etterskudd?', 'hvem mangler opplæring?', or needs to identify C4-compliance gaps.

tools.name: listOpenDeviations
tools.description: List open C4-layer deviations (open + acknowledged + escalated). Includes severity, domain, department, and whether the deviation blocks day-approval. Use when manager asks 'hvilke avvik er åpne?', 'blokkerer noe dag-godkjenning?'.

tools.name: proposeAssignProtocol
tools.description: Open the assign-protocol sheet pre-filled for a protocol so manager can select employees and confirm. Use when manager says 'tildel [protokollnavn] til ansatte' or wants to assign training. NEVER assigns directly — sheet requires manual confirmation.

tools.name: proposeCreateDeviation
tools.description: Navigate to the deviations tab so manager can create a new C4-layer deviation. Use when manager says 'meld et avvik' or 'logg et avvik'. Does not pre-fill the form — opens the deviation tab where the DeviationForm is accessible.

tools.name: switchGovernanceTab
tools.description: Navigate to a specific HMS sub-tab. Use when manager asks to go to opplæring, avvik, drift, dokumenter, or governance admin. Accepts: oversikt | drift | training | documents | deviations | governance.

routes.purpose: Plan and visualize seasons, demand factors, and operating-hours generation across the year — D4/D5 cascade authoring.

tools.name: getYearWheelState
tools.description: Get the year wheel's current state — displayed year, active season name, sidebar filter, total season and planning event counts. Call first when answering open-ended questions about the season calendar (D4 demand signal surface).

tools.name: listSeasons
tools.description: List seasons for the current workspace, optionally filtered by status (active/draft/archived). Use when user asks 'hvilke sesonger finnes?', 'vis utkast', or 'hva er den aktive sesongen?'. Seasons are the D4/D5 authoring unit — they carry revenue budget, day factors, and hour factors.

tools.name: getSeasonDetail
tools.description: Get full detail for a specific season — dates, status, whether D1 operating-hours have been seeded, and a short activation-readiness note. Use when user asks about a specific season by name or when proposing to activate/archive one.

tools.name: listPlanningEvents
tools.description: List D4 planning events visible in the current year — holidays, campaigns, demand peaks. Use when user asks 'hva skjer i høst?', 'vis hendelser i desember', or needs context for season demand planning.

tools.name: getSeasonProgress
tools.description: Check activation readiness for a draft season — returns whether budget, day factors, and hour factors are configured (D4 completeness). Use when user asks 'kan jeg aktivere [sesong]?' or 'hva mangler for å aktivere?'.

tools.name: proposeActivateSeason
tools.description: Activate a draft season — calls the server action, archives the currently active season atomically, and seeds D1 operating hours fanout. Use when user explicitly says 'aktiver [sesong]' or confirms activation after getSeasonProgress. Requires the season to have budget + day factors + hour factors set.

tools.name: proposeArchiveSeason
tools.description: Archive a season (draft or active → archived). Use when user says 'arkiver [sesong]' or wants to move a draft to archived state. Idempotent — safe to call on already-archived seasons.

routes.purpose: Close the day — approve shifts, lock daily_reconciliation, resolve deviations. C1 calibration + C3 commercial outcome surface.

tools.name: getReconciliationState
tools.description: Get the current reconciliation page state — whether a day is open in detail view, its id, and summary counters (venter oppgjør, klar til å låse, låst). Call first when manager asks any open-ended question about avstemming.

tools.name: listReconciliationDays
tools.description: List reconciliation days with status, omsetning, and labor %. Use when manager asks 'hvilke dager venter oppgjør?', 'vis forrige ukes avstemminger', or wants an overview of recent days. Optionally filter by status or date range.

tools.name: getReconciliationDetail
tools.description: Get full detail for a specific reconciliation_id — revenue breakdown, labor %, session info, preflight blocker count. Use when manager asks 'hva er status på lørdag?' and a reconciliation is already selected, or call after switchDate.

tools.name: listPendingHours
tools.description: List shift approvals still waiting for timegodkjenning for a reconciliation. Use when manager asks 'hvilke vakter mangler godkjenning?' or 'er det timer som ikke er godkjent?'.

tools.name: listDeviationsForDay
tools.description: List deviations for a reconciliation — status, severity, whether they block approval. Use when manager asks 'hvilke avvik blokkerer godkjenning?' or 'vis avvik for denne dagen'.

tools.name: switchDate
tools.description: Open a specific reconciliation in detail view by id or date. Use when manager says 'åpne oppgjøret for fredag', 'gå til lørdag', or names a specific day. Resolves by date if date given, by id if UUID given.

routes.purpose: Season detail — D4/D5 authoring: budget, day/hour factors, operating-hours generation, activation readiness.

tools.name: getSeasonStatus
tools.description: Get the current season's metadata — name, status (draft/active/archived), start/end dates, season type, and planning cycle linkage. Call first when the user asks about this specific season or before proposing any action on it.

tools.name: getActivationReadiness
tools.description: Check whether this draft season is ready to activate — returns the D4 completeness checklist: budget set, day factors configured, hour factors configured, and whether season-specific operating hours exist (soft check). Use when user asks 'kan jeg aktivere denne sesongen?' or 'hva mangler?'.

tools.name: getBudgetSummary
tools.description: Return this season's D4 revenue budget — total target revenue (NOK), labor percentage, average hourly wage, base price per guest, and budget status (draft/active/locked). Use when user asks about revenue targets, cost ratios, or staffing economics for this season.

tools.name: getFactorSummary
tools.description: Summarise the D4 day-factor and hour-factor distribution for this season — highest/lowest weekday weights, peak operating hour. Use when user asks 'hvilken dag er høyest?', 'når er det travlest?', or needs to understand the demand distribution before activating.

tools.name: proposeActivateSeason
tools.description: Activate this season — calls the server action, archives the currently active season atomically, and seeds D1 operating-hours fanout. Use when user explicitly says 'aktiver denne sesongen' or confirms after getActivationReadiness shows all checks pass. Requires budget + day factors + hour factors.

tools.name: proposeArchiveSeason
tools.description: Archive this season (draft or active → archived). Use when user says 'arkiver denne sesongen' or wants to move it to archived state. Idempotent — safe to call if already archived.
